name: Corsair
summary: Corsair; You gain proficiency with pistols and blades. After making a weapon attack, move 5 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.  Corsair; Your Shuriken Grace damage applies to pistol attacks.  Corsair; After scoring a critical hit, you may make one pistol or blade attack as a bonus action.  Corsair; After you move 5 ft from your Corsair feature, your next attack before your next turn gains +1d6 damage.
descriptionMarkdown:
Corsair; You gain proficiency with pistols and blades. After making a weapon attack, move 5 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.

Corsair; Your Shuriken Grace damage applies to pistol attacks.

Corsair; After scoring a critical hit, you may make one pistol or blade attack as a bonus action.

Corsair; After you move 5 ft from your Corsair feature, your next attack before your next turn gains +1d6 damage.
